node.validation: Authenticated node listing identified the target node.

physical_cores.validation: Host CPU topology observation recorded physical cores.

physical_threads.validation: Host CPU topology observation recorded online logical CPUs.

usable_memory_mib.validation: Node status reported approximately 94.0338 GiB physical RAM.

storage_pools.validation: Target-pool capacity check includes existing and planned commitments and exceeds the approved reserve.

existing_committed_vcpu.validation: Fresh guest inventory summed configured vCPUs for retained guests.

existing_committed_memory_mib.validation: Fresh guest inventory summed configured memory for retained guests.

measurement_timestamp.validation: Evidence was consolidated from the operator-assisted read-only session.

bridge.validation: Bridge matched the existing LAN guest network.

vlan.validation: The active vmbr0 bridge has no VLAN tag and bridge VLAN awareness is unset, confirming untagged LAN attachment.

subnet.validation: Subnet matched Proxmox and RouterOS observations.

gateway.validation: Gateway was read from RouterOS address state.

dns_suffix.validation: Operator approved the platform application suffix.

dhcp_exclusion_static_range.validation: The selected .100-.102 addresses were included in collision probes that returned no response.

npm_identity.validation: Operator confirmed the existing local DNS identity and authenticated NPM API access verified the host.

minimum_memory_headroom_percent.validation: Existing 52736 MiB plus planned 20480 MiB leaves approximately 23.9 percent and passes.

minimum_storage_headroom_percent.validation: local-lvm existing 323.15 GiB plus planned 192 GiB leaves approximately 69.9 percent and passes.

guests.service_readiness_contract: Docker Compose controls internal startup order with service health checks; Proxmox startup metadata applies only to services-01 as a VM.

services.readiness: Compose health check must pass before dependent services are ready.
Compose health check must confirm NATS and JetStream availability.
Compose dependency checks require reachable PostgreSQL and healthy NATS before Debezium readiness.

guests.lifecycle_constraint: observe-only and unresized in Phase 1; approved startup metadata is recorded for later mutation by its owner

order.validation: Approved desired metadata for later mutation; no Phase 1 change was made.

delay_seconds.validation: Approved desired metadata for later mutation; no Phase 1 change was made.

measurement_source.value: Proxmox PVEAuditor API guest list and LXC configuration

responsibilities.boundary: The three declared new Proxmox guests and explicitly declared external infrastructure; never Kubernetes resources or existing manual guests
PostgreSQL inside postgres-01 and Docker Compose plus services inside services-01; Docker-in-LXC is prohibited
Desired state inside k3s only; never guests, routers, DNS providers, or proxy lifecycle
Existing Zitadel, NPM, Cloudflared, Frigate, and other retained systems unless a later approved contract changes ownership

credentials.minimum_scope: Dedicated role limited to required VM/LXC and storage lifecycle on the target node
Read network/DHCP state and manage only platform static DNS entries
Manage platform proxy hosts and certificates without administrative-system exposure
Zone-scoped DNS edit and zone read for kayage.co and hapa.dev
Contents read/write only on explicitly selected application and tkayage/gitops-homelab repositories
Read packages for only the required private container packages
